name: Twemoji
attribution: Twemoji graphics by Twitter, Inc. and other contributors; maintained by Jason Sofonia, Justine De Caires, and the Twemoji community.
modifications: Original 72x72 PNG artwork resized to 32x32 with Pillow LANCZOS and packed into one RGBA atlas with transparent 2-pixel gutters; unused bottom rows transparently pad the image to power-of-two dimensions.
mapping_format: First line: width height. Remaining lines: sequence TAB x TAB y TAB width TAB height; sequence is lowercase hexadecimal codepoints separated by hyphens.

shortcodes.source_generated_by: Discord Emoji Map generator by Emzi0767

supplemental_aliases.pinata: ASCII spelling of source alias piñata

shortcodes.format: UTF-8 TSV, no header; alias without outer colons TAB lowercase hexadecimal codepoints joined by hyphens. Compound aliases may retain internal colons. Original source Unicode values, including VS16, are preserved.

comparison.note: Current live canary data is newer than the C# snapshot; generated compound skin-tone alias forms are absent from the JSON direct names arrays. Live JSON was inspected only and is not redistributed.

picker.format: UTF-8 TSV with # comment header; category TAB canonical display/search name TAB exact atlas hexadecimal sequence.
picker.input_text_hash_normalization: Existing mapping.txt and shortcodes.txt inputs are checked after CRLF-to-LF normalization so either platform's Git text checkout regenerates identical metadata.
picker.order: Discord Canary definition-array order within category, deduplicated by atlas glyph; missing Emoji 17 entries appended in Unicode CLDR order using their known family base's category when available; 30 upstream extension assets appended deterministically.
picker.name_sources: Existing MIT-licensed DSharpPlus shortcode names preferred; Unicode 17 descriptions or explicit labels for upstream extensions otherwise. Fallback labels do not add registered shortcodes.
picker.extension_notes: 12 gendered Santa sequences, 12 gendered levitation sequences, 5 skier skin tones, and private-use U+E50A Shibuya 109 building.

skin_tone_families.format: UTF-8 TSV with # comment header; base atlas sequence TAB tone integer TAB variant atlas sequence. Tones 1..5 select uniform light through dark; tone 0 records mixed-variant reverse family membership only. Default yellow is the base glyph itself.
skin_tone_families.validation: All 335 families have five real uniform atlas variants; all 2055 modified emoji glyphs have one unambiguous reverse family; five standalone modifier components are preserved separately.
